title: Little Makers: Kids Learning
short_description: A creative village with coloring, clay, stories, books and learning games.
full_description:
A LITTLE WORLD TO MAKE THEIR OWN
Explore an illustrated village through native Android creative play. Visit Color meadow for 1,053 bundled picture entries, Texture garden for scratch-to-reveal play, and Story tree for 210 scripted interactive episodes. Drag story props into place and choose an ending. Episodes share reusable scene mechanics; these are not 210 separate videos.

MAKE AND KEEP
Brush pictures by hand, draw in a practice notebook, connect dots and keep creations in a private on-device gallery. Shape and rotate a shaded clay mesh on supported OpenGL ES 2 devices; a simpler Canvas sculpting fallback is available. The Android translation uses the original web artwork and story scripts. It is still being verified for full feature parity with the web edition.

1,200 ACTIVITY LEVELS
The playroom retains 20 game types with 60 numbered levels each, including counting, arithmetic, shapes, colors, memory, tracing, mazes, sequencing, blocks, rhythm and planning. These are variations across reusable mechanics, not 1,200 unrelated game engines or a complete school curriculum.

PLAY AND PERSONALIZE
First completion of a mini-game or supported creative challenge earns a star and fixed virtual coins. Use earned coins for character colors and accessories. Coins have no cash value and cannot be bought with money. Replay freely.

FAMILY SETTINGS
Choose light, dark or system theme, optional sound, and reduced motion. A local parent PIN protects settings and reset. Reset removes local progress and creative artwork while keeping family settings and the PIN.

OFFLINE AND PRIVATE
No ads, child accounts, public gallery, third-party game links, analytics or Internet permission. Artwork, drafts, progress, cosmetics and settings stay on this device. The app has an offline privacy policy and artwork credits. Picture art is by OpenMoji contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0); story sprites are by Kenney (CC0).

Little Makers offers practice and play. It does not assess development or promise learning outcomes. Parents can choose activities appropriate to their child and take breaks together.

Requires Android 7.0 or later.
